description: Get account or per-ad statistics for a time range. from/to accept Unix seconds, milliseconds, or ISO 8601. interval is 86400 (daily, default) or 300 (5 minutes). Ranges above 1000 intervals are split automatically. Always returns totals and derived CTR/CPM/CPC; set include_series for the raw time series. Timestamps are inclusive for from and exclusive for to.
name: tg_get_stats
title: Get advertising stats
